The '''Heroes of Bothawui''' were the men and women of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who participated in the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second battle]] at [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] in [[3671 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]].
